ssoProjectSetting: Vercel Authentication (Standard Protection) is still enabled at the project level: the public production URL is served without any SSO redirect (HTTP 200), but internal deployment URLs (proklinator-live-<hash>-singularity16.vercel.app, proklinator-live-singularity16.vercel.app) still 302 to vercel.com/sso-api. update_project_deployment_protection returned 404 'Project not found' for projectId=proklinator-live under teamId team_9A6kPxSgwyImFWwEzrJ0tMbi and slug singularity16, so the setting must be disabled in the dashboard (Project Settings -> Deployment Protection -> Vercel Authentication -> Disabled) or after re-authorizing the Vercel MCP with team access.

alternateDeployment.note: Same content, Vercel Authentication fully off (deployment URLs return 200 unauthenticated).

notes: deploy_to_vercel with an explicit teamId (team_9A6kPxSgwyImFWwEzrJ0tMbi) returned 403 'You don't have permission to create a Production Deployment for this project' for proklinator-live as well as proklinator and proklinator-static; deploying to the token's default scope (same slug, singularity16) succeeded.

Team-scoped MCP tools (list_projects, get_project, get_deployment, update_project_deployment_protection) cannot see these projects (404 / empty) under either the team id or the slug, and the tools reject an empty teamId.

The ~386 KB of site files were not inlined in the deployment request; the deployment's build step (build.mjs, outputDirectory=public) fetches index.html and hero-altar.jpg and fails unless their SHA-256 digests match the pinned values above, so the deployment can only contain the exact repo bytes. Sources are the immutable proklinator deployments (same bytes) with short-lived mirrors as fallback.

create_git_project failed because the Vercel account has no GitHub Login Connection; adding one (vercel.com/account/login-connections) would allow linking this private repo for automatic deploys from main.
